sections.heading: From dialogue to outcomes
paragraphs: A conference can matter when consultation informs policy, implementation assigns responsibility and monitoring captures farmer outcomes. Its practical value should therefore be judged by follow-up rather than participation alone.
A common misconception is that participation itself proves agricultural progress. The supplied record does not provide evidence for that conclusion.

Include small and marginal farmers, women farmers, tenant farmers and diverse regions in decision-making.
Track outcomes through transparent indicators covering incomes, risk, sustainability, market access and inclusion.
Create feedback mechanisms so farmer experience informs subsequent policy correction.
